title: •Princess Leia
caption: •Princess Leia (V)
game_text: May deploy or move as a ‘react’ to same site as an Imperial. Adds one battle destiny if with Han or Vader. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Leia Of Alderaan, Reflection, or a matching blaster on Leia. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Prominent leader in the struggling Alliance. Former member of the Imperial Senate. Beginning to discover her true heritage. Likes scoundrels.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 4 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 7. Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Rebel (Cloud City frame, Rebel disc). Curly single quotes around ‘react’; the slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. The wiki's default 'Princess Leia' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Princess Leia (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px CC-L-princessleia.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face; it also prints 'leader' in bold in the lore) — downloaded to src/vs6/17-CC-L-princessleia.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src, where 'leader' is plain. Lore matches the wiki. Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: V1-L-princessleia.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 1 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
